feature: Settings has a new layout that matches the other tools, with a summary of what your settings mean. Reset now asks for a second tap, since it resets every setting.
Import measured antenna patterns (MSI / Planet files) for Coverage sites and Mesh nodes, under the new Antenna patterns button. Sites and nodes using one plan with the file's own shape and gain.
Release notes: when an update is ready, the Update button in the top bar shows what changed before you reload.
fix: The antenna pattern view no longer adds a background listener every time you open it.
